describe.description: The monitor: source, roster, nominal band, open session, and whether readings are simulated.

presence.description: Occupants of every module. Read before proposing a test on a volume.

monitor_start.description: Open monitoring over the occupants of the given modules for a procedure.

monitor_stop.description: Close the monitoring session and return its record.

report.description: Relay one chest strap reading: beats per minute, and beat intervals when sent.

state.description: Monitored subjects with last rate, band and status.

verdict.description: One line on whether to abort. This slot stops nothing.

move.description: Put a subject in a module. Scenario control.

alarm.title: Raise a critical health alarm
alarm.description: A critical health alarm for one person, raised by someone who saw it. It stays until cleared: a test that exposes the person stops, and no procedure may expose them meanwhile.

alarm_clear.title: Clear a health alarm
alarm_clear.description: The person is safe: the alarm is cleared by someone who says so.
